g.text: radix M = max automaton states per dict node, with 0 ≤ a < M
compact u32, one contiguous band per d
A bijection: encode packs the pair into one u32; decode recovers it exactly.
Each dictionary node d owns the contiguous band [dM, dM + M), so distinct
pairs never alias. Example — query "helo" (n = 4), k = 2, c = 1 ⇒ M = 5·3·1 = 15;
